topic: cook rice so it doesn't stick or burn
core_question: How do I cook rice on the stove so it comes out fluffy and doesn't burn or stick?
answer_summary: Use the correct water-to-rice ratio, bring to a boil, reduce to a low simmer, cover tightly and cook undisturbed, then rest off heat before fluffing with a fork.
persona: anxious and rambling; writing terse one-liners
